sources.title: Scape home
sources.locator: Download, Your tools in your project, pricing/trial and FAQ
sources.finding: The site documents a Mac download, parallel local sessions, Git worktrees, external integration records and a14-day trial that locks after expiry without a paid plan.

sources.title: Scape harnesses
sources.locator: Harness/CLI table; Capability differences; Installing sections; account profiles
sources.finding: The agent guide names nine coding CLI harnesses, exact commands and per-harness authentication/capability limits. Only Claude Code is listed for remote SSH sessions.

sources.title: Scape argus-doc
sources.locator: Creating an Argus; How it works; Modes; Scheduled Events
sources.finding: Argus is a long-lived product manager session that reads a mission, starts real child sessions in worktrees and monitors/messages them. It has Watching/Sleeping/Disabled modes and future scheduled events.

sources.title: Scape triggers
sources.locator: Opening warning; When table; Creating a trigger and arming
sources.finding: Product triggers react to webhooks, integration records, table queries and calendar events, after human arming. Evaluation requires Scape open; webhook arming requires Supporter.

sources.title: Scape ssh
sources.locator: Using SSH connections; Remote worktrees; Session status on remote hosts
sources.finding: Saved SSH profiles support remote terminals/SFTP and Claude coding sessions, with remote worktree creation scoped to a live matching connection.

sources.title: Scape cli
sources.locator: Beta notice; Start an agent; URL restrictions
sources.finding: The beta scape CLI opens/focuses projects and can start installed agents with a prompt/model; URL schemes cannot start an agent.

sources.title: Scape code-editor
sources.locator: Diff view: original HEAD content versus current content, next/previous hunk controls
sources.finding: Show Diff displays git show HEAD:<file> against current file content side by side and lets users navigate actual changed hunks.

sources.title: Scape privacy
sources.locator: AI Coding Agents; relay; Website Analytics; What We Do Not Collect
sources.finding: Policy distinguishes no desktop usage telemetry from opt-in marketing-site PostHog analytics, optional relay operational metadata, Keygen activation and model-provider traffic.

sources.title: Scape terms
sources.locator: 2 Software License; 3 Purchase Options; 6 Intellectual Property; 7 Prohibited Uses
sources.finding: The application has a restricted macOS software license; paid use, no free tier and specific older plan/price wording are stated. Redistribution/reverse engineering is prohibited.
